subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should the existing provider-billed transcript aggregate be exposed through `session_status`, or should OpenClaw add a dedicated agent-callable usage tool for exact per-turn and cumulative cost?
rationale: The accounting and provenance implementation now exists, but maintainers must choose the durable public agent API, aggregation shape, units, and exact-versus-estimated precedence.

options.title: Extend session status
options.body: Add source-tagged last-turn and cumulative billed-cost fields to the existing `session_status` result while keeping estimates distinct.

options.title: Dedicated usage tool
options.body: Add a richer agent-callable tool for per-call, model, and date-range usage and cost queries.

options.title: Keep operator-only
options.body: Leave exact billed cost available only through transcripts, gateway usage RPCs, user commands, and operator interfaces.

recommendation.title: Extend session status
recommendation.body: Add source-tagged last-turn and cumulative billed-cost fields to the existing `session_status` result while keeping estimates distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-status ownership and the prior review of this issue make steipete the strongest available owner for the remaining public API decision.
